{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Directly modifies `src/index/txindex.cpp`, `src/index/base.cpp`, and related index headers to enable running txindex in pruned mode and handling pruned lookups.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.72,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Enables running txindex simultaneously with block pruning, lifting a long-standing mutual exclusion for resource-constrained nodes. As noted in the description, 'users running pruned nodes due to disk space constraints could not index transactions... without re-downloading and retaining the entire blockchain,' delivering substantial value to node operators."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies `src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp`, `src/rpc/txoutproof.cpp`, and `src/rest.cpp` to return candidate block hashes when indexed transactions reside in pruned blocks.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.60,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Updates transaction lookup RPC and REST endpoints to return candidate block hashes on pruned lookups, allowing clients to fetch missing blocks via `getblockfrompeer`. This directly enhances the programmatic interface for clients operating on pruned nodes."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "The changes in test files (`test/functional/feature_txindex_prune.py`, `src/test/txindex_tests.cpp`) and the test runner specifically cover the new txindex functionality rather than test framework infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Test changes follow directly from the index feature and do not modify shared test framework machinery."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits in `src/init.cpp` merely remove the check enforcing mutual exclusion between `-prune` and `-txindex`.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Startup option validation changes in `src/init.cpp` are secondary consequences of the txindex feature rather than shared utility work."
    }
  ],

  }
}
